notes.title: “Women are to be silent in the churches”
notes.intro: These verses are central to debates about women’s roles in church leadership.

views.label: Women are not ordained as priests or pastors
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox churches, and many conservative Protestant churches, reserve ordained leadership for men, though they read this passage in its context of disorderly worship.
views.source: Pope John Paul II, Ordinatio Sacerdotalis (1994); 1 Timothy 2:12

views.label: About disruption in that church, not a universal ban
views.summary: Many churches note that Paul expects women to pray and prophesy (11:5) and read this as addressing specific disorder; they ordain women.
views.source: United Methodist Book of Discipline; Margaret Fell, Women’s Speaking Justified (1666)

views.label: Practice varies by church
views.summary: Baptist and non-denominational churches vary: some have women pastors, others do not.
views.source: Baptist Faith and Message (2000), Article VI
